items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Warren Bennett playing alto, Lucen Johnson was playing alto, I was playing tenor.

ctx.x: Sorry we didn't bring that picture here tonight. Yeah. But do you remember who else was in the band? Well yeah.

I was going to tell you, Harry Faglitude on a banjo, Warren Bennett playing alto, Lucen Johnson was playing alto, I was playing tenor. And later on Warren Lesbavis got Oliver Alcorn, because Oliver made the tour with us. And because Warren, just like I told you, Warren wanted to go back to Mississippi and put that roof on his house. So when I had Warren was very good and Oliver was good and Lucien Johnson, well after Warren left the band, Lucien Johnson was playing the clarinet solos. And I was playing tenor and…

By the way, one time there was a little brother Montgomery, he came from Mississippi. Did he ever bring him? We picked him up in Jackson, Mississippi. Well he played with us. He played with your son of Montgomery. He played with us at the same time. He made it too with us.

items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: And his cousin was playing with us at that time.

ctx.x: You were saying that when Brother played the blues, first one or two came around and then... Everybody started. And they were just watching him...

That was the place, the first place I took a drink in my life. They were just watching him play. That's right. They enjoyed it so much. They enjoyed him and he was playing. I mean, he could... In other words, he could stop a dance when he got ready. Yeah. Yeah. And he left us and we picked up a woman by the name of Vivian from Atkins, Kansas. And she was very good paying up there too. She came up with a band that we came down there. And you know, until the band... Things like a little tough and bad. But she was a…

items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: And also Warren Bennett also. And just stayed around here a long time. Yeah. I used to go around and play with him sometime.

ctx.x: Do they swing as much as the ones here? I mean, were they in the class with the ones here, or do you think they...

Well, I tell you, see, most of them bars from over there, they just come over here and play. You see, Tio lived over there a while, too. Yeah. And you think I had a thing to leave from Basin Lewis, but in the 20s he traveled with us all over the country. And he stayed here a good while. And also Warren Bennett also. And just stayed around here a long time. Yeah. I used to go around and play with him sometime. But they can play. They can play. No doubt about that. They can play. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Did you ever…
the old Ninegrass bands when you were a boy and following them what they were like?
